name: Entity Version History
description: Adds a per-entity 'History' tab that lists the distinct version numbers across an entity's revisions in a table.
project_description: Sub-module of Entity Version. Adds a 'History' local task (tab) to revisionable content entities whose bundle has a configured main version field, listing the distinct version numbers found across the entity's revisions in a table with the revision title, date and author. The tab is created by an entity_type_alter that sets an 'entity-version-history' link template plus a route subscriber and a local-task deriver; the page is served by EntityVersionHistoryController and gated by the 'access entity version history' permission.
